title: The Powder Day Crew
catchphrase: Somehow we always make it down.
beats: THE RENTAL SHOP LOST THE BOOT SIZES.
SOMEONE PACKED SHORTS INSTEAD OF SNOW PANTS.
THE CHAIRLIFT STOPPED FOR FORTY MINUTES.
NOBODY COULD FIND THE CABIN IN THE DARK.
THE HOT TUB WAS SOMEHOW STILL ICE COLD.
finalBossQuirk: Still mad about the wet boots by the fire.

cast.butterfingers: The One Who Dropped The GoPro

anecdotes.critic: Judges every turn from the lift line.
anecdotes.boss: Remembers every pair of wet boots left by the fire.
anecdotes.savior: Always has one more granola bar than anyone asked for.
anecdotes.butterfingers: Has lost count of how many lens caps are buried in the snow.
anecdotes.builder: Built this exact game after the drive home.
